title: Branch

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Branch is an early game Resource that can be commonly found on the ground within the Meadows and Black Forest biomes.
When interacted with, the branch will be picked up providing the player one Wood.
Branches will naturally respawn 4 hours after being picked.

Branch

Introduction. The Branch is an early game Resource that can be commonly found on the ground within the Meadows and Black Forest biomes.
When interacted with, the branch will be picked up providing the player one Wood.
Branches will naturally respawn 4 hours after being picked.
